headline: APC Presidential Campaign Council Centralizes Media Communication
metaDescription: The All Progressives Congress has officially restricted its media communication to three designated spokespeople as election preparations continue.
aiSummaryBullets: The APC Presidential Campaign Council has authorized only three individuals to act as official media representatives.
The designated spokespersons for the campaign are Abdulaziz Yari, Dele Alake, and Mohammed Idris.
Broadcasting stations have been advised to adhere to this new communication structure for all campaign-related statements.
aiContextParagraph: The All Progressives Congress (APC) has reorganized its media directorate as the party intensifies preparations for future electoral cycles. Following a directive from the campaign leadership, all official communication regarding the presidential campaign will now be funneled through a restricted group of three designated individuals: Abdulaziz Yari, Dele Alake, and Mohammed Idris. This policy shift is intended to streamline public messaging and ensure consistency in the party's outreach. While the party continues to mobilize support across various regions, including recent efforts in Jigawa and Ondo, the restructuring aims to tighten control over official narrative dissemination. Broadcast organizations have been formally notified to recognize only these authorized spokespersons when engaging with the campaign. This development coincides with ongoing internal discussions regarding the party's political strategy, including recent remarks by party officials concerning election history and administrative achievements during the current presidential term.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to the official consolidation of media messaging by a major political party, which has drawn significant attention from Nigerian news outlets and public observers.
